items.title: Approval of Minutes of April 21, 2020 Regular Meeting
Announcement of prohibition of sound producing devices during the meeting
Introduction of New or Unfinished Business by Board Members

All matters listed hereunder constitute a Consent Calendar, are considered to be routine by the San Francisco Municipal Transportation Agency Board of Directors and will be acted upon by a single vote
Requesting the Controller to allot funds and to draw warrants against such funds available or will be available in payment of the following claims against the SFMTA
Authorizing the Director to file a claim with the Metropolitan Transportation Commission for allocation of operating assistance for Fiscal Year 2021
Authorizing the Director to accept and expend up to $608,000 in Fiscal Year 2021 Transportation Development Act Article 3 funds for the San Francisco Active Communities Plan
Authorizing the Director to execute unilateral Modification No. 10 to Van Ness Corridor Transit Improvement Project for additional costs related to modifications
Appointing Steve Heminger to the Bond Oversight Committee, effective June 1, 2020
Presentation and discussion regarding the SFMTA’s Covid-19 Recovery and Restart Planning process
